items.label: 真题
items.english: Members of social networks are learning that they can hijack media to apply pressure on the businesses that originally created them.
items.translation: 社交网络用户正领悟到，他们可以通过劫持媒体来对最初创建该媒体的企业施加压力。

items.label: 真题
items.english: Some growth stems from a commitment by governments and farsighted businesses to fund cleaner energy sources.
items.translation: 一些增长源于各国政府和有远见的企业为更清洁的能源提供资金的一个承诺。
items.reason: 固定搭配起源于，不等于主词所列阻止；另存关联资料。

items.label: 例
items.english: Adapt your usual eating regime to make it more nutritious.
items.translation: 调整你的日常饮食习惯，使之更富有营养。
items.note: 依据PDF77补回此前转录遗漏的“日”字。

items.label: 真题
items.english: The use of privacy law to curb the tech giants in this instance feels slightly maladapted.
items.translation: 本案中用隐私法限制科技巨头似乎稍显牵强。

items.label: 真题
items.english: Children of every age benefit from patient parenting.
items.translation: 每个年龄的孩子都受益于耐心的养育。

items.label: 例
items.english: Individuality is a valued and inherent part of the British character.
items.translation: 个性是英国人重视并固有的特征。

items.label: 例
items.english: The Green Alliance was formed to campaign against environmental damage.
items.translation: 绿色联盟的成立是为了开展反对破坏环境的运动。

items.label: 真题
items.english: Employers are more cautious about hiring new staff.
items.translation: 雇主对雇佣新员工更加谨慎。

items.label: 真题
items.english: You really need a magnifying glass to appreciate all the fine detail.
items.translation: 你需要放大镜才能欣赏到一切细微之处。
items.reason: 原句使用名词短语magnifying glass（放大镜），另存关联材料。

items.label: 例
items.english: Her story was a complete fabrication from start to finish.
items.translation: 她的叙述从头至尾都是编造出来的。

items.label: 真题
items.english: During their six- to twelve-week voyage, they survived on barely enough food allotted to them.
items.translation: 在六到十二周的航行中，他们靠分配给他们的食物勉强维持生计。

items.label: 真题
items.english: It is financially terrifying, psychologically embarrassing.
items.translation: 从经济上来说是可怕的，从心理上说是尴尬的。

items.label: 真题
items.english: With them, there’s not the same embarrassment as when buying one carrot in a little greengrocer.
items.translation: 有了它们，就不会像在小蔬菜水果店买一根胡萝卜那样尴尬。
